cost.value: valuable items of whimsy and sweet foodstuffs worth 500 gp

description.value:
You treat with the fey of a nearby faerie circle to grant you and all secondary casters safe passage to another faerie circle anywhere on the same plane. The fey might test your worthiness by setting you tasks related to the primary or secondary checks used. Once you've been granted entry to the faerie circle, you become temporarily aware of all other faerie circles on the plane and can choose any of them to travel to. After the ritual, you forget the locations of all faerie circles discovered this way.

Critical Success The fey grant your request, teleporting you to the faerie circle of your choosing. You endear the fey to you, both at your point of origin and destination. You can automatically use faerie circle hop between these two faerie circles again within the next month without spending the cost or making checks, as long as all travelers party with the fey for 1 day first.

Success The fey teleport you to the faerie circle of your choosing.

Failure The ritual has no effect, and all fey know of your failure, granting a –2 circumstance penalty to your future attempts to cast faerie circle hop for 1 month.

Critical Failure As failure, but you anger the fey. They afflict you and all secondary casters with the curse of the interloper at your level (see above).

secondary.checks: Diplomacy, Nature, or Occultism (whichever isn't used for the primary check), Survival
